title: Minimum XOR Sum of Two Arrays
goal: Minimize XOR sum by assigning second-array positions to first-array positions.
strategy: A bitmask records used second-array positions. Its population count identifies the next first-array entry, making all assignment histories with the same mask share one best cost.
